audit_status.source_base: ChatGPT-authored Psalms completion draft using public-domain KJV as familiar alignment scaffold with curated Hebrew/textual overrides; full WLC/OSHB/source-witness audit pending
audit_status.review_note: Vengeance, violent rulers, oppression, widow/orphan/foreigner, discipline, and justice.

verses.restored: YHWH, God of vengeance—God of vengeance, shine forth.

familiar.text: O Lord God, to whom vengeance belongeth; O God, to whom vengeance belongeth, shew thyself.

notes.title: God of vengeance
notes.body: The psalm places vengeance in divine hands rather than granting private permission for retaliation. It must not be used to authorize vigilantism, abuse, harassment, or political violence.

verses.restored: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: render a reward to the proud.

familiar.text: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: render a reward to the proud.

verses.restored: YHWH, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked triumph?

familiar.text: LORD, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked triumph?

verses.restored: How long shall they utter and speak hard things? and all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?

familiar.text: How long shall they utter and speak hard things? and all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?

verses.restored: They break in pieces thy people, O YHWH, and afflict thine heritage.

familiar.text: They break in pieces thy people, O LORD, and afflict thine heritage.

verses.restored: They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.

familiar.text: They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.

verses.restored: Yet they say, YHWH shall not see, neither shall the God of Jacob regard it.

familiar.text: Yet they say, The LORD shall not see, neither shall the God of Jacob regard it.

verses.restored: Understand, ye brutish among the people: and ye fools, when will ye be wise?

familiar.text: Understand, ye brutish among the people: and ye fools, when will ye be wise?

verses.restored: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? he that formed the eye, shall he not see?

familiar.text: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? he that formed the eye, shall he not see?

verses.restored: He that chastiseth the nations, shall not he correct? he that teacheth man knowledge, shall not he know?

familiar.text: He that chastiseth the heathen, shall not he correct? he that teacheth man knowledge, shall not he know?

verses.restored: YHWH knoweth the thoughts of man, that they are vanity.

familiar.text: The LORD knoweth the thoughts of man, that they are vanity.

verses.restored: Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O YHWH, and teachest him out of thy law;

familiar.text: Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O LORD, and teachest him out of thy law;

verses.restored: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit be digged for the wicked.

familiar.text: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit be digged for the wicked.

verses.restored: For YHWH will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.

familiar.text: For the LORD will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.

verses.restored: But judgment shall return to righteousness: and all the upright in heart shall follow it.

familiar.text: But judgment shall return unto righteousness: and all the upright in heart shall follow it.

verses.restored: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?

familiar.text: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?

verses.restored: Unless YHWH had been my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.

familiar.text: Unless the LORD had been my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.

verses.restored: When I said, My foot slippeth; thy mercy, O YHWH, held me up.

familiar.text: When I said, My foot slippeth; thy mercy, O LORD, held me up.

verses.restored: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.

familiar.text: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.

verses.restored: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?

familiar.text: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?

verses.restored: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.

familiar.text: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.

verses.restored: But YHWH is my defence; and my God is the rock of my refuge.

familiar.text: But the LORD is my defence; and my God is the rock of my refuge.

verses.restored: And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity, and shall cut them off in their own wickedness; yea, YHWH our God shall cut them off.

familiar.text: And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity, and shall cut them off in their own wickedness; yea, the LORD our God shall cut them off.

translation_notes: This chapter completes corpus coverage as a ChatGPT-authored draft. KJV is retained as a familiar comparison layer; a separate automated reference pass adds BSB and pointed Hebrew without replacing the restored draft.
safety_note: Vengeance belongs to God in the poem; it is not authorization for retaliation, vigilantism, abuse, or political violence.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Psalms witnesses where extant, and other textual witnesses during the global audit. Preserve poetic parallelism, superscriptions, acrostic structure, duplicate/reused psalms, and significant Hebrew/Greek divergences rather than harmonizing them.
